title: Dashboard Shell — one responsive shell + mobile dock
description: The single dashboard chrome: persistent collapsible rail + topbar on desktop, sheet sidebar + bottom dock on mobile. ONE `nav` prop (groups → items → one level of sub-items) is the SSOT for both faces — the dock derives from the same items (flag `dock: true`, or it takes the first few), so there is no second mobile nav to keep in sync. Slots for everything project-specific: sidebarHeader (workspace switcher), sidebarFooter (user menu), actions (search/notifications), topbar (full replace), secondary (narrow contextual column = the old three-column 'advanced' archetype). Breakpoints are shadcn's Sidebar sheet plus a `md:hidden` dock — no viewport measuring, no hydration flash. Zero backend: pass `activePath` to drive it from state, or let it read usePathname().
